answer: Slot auctions make parallel fakes buy the clock. Each epoch the ledger sells one raven, a 60-second exclusive claim window, per knoll, a shard of 256 address prefixes. Claiming a reward requires holding that raven and posting a bridge, a 100 POA bid that burns if two keys bid the same window; shared solvers collide inside one knoll and burn every colliding bridge, so the shared bid line pays nothing. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 distinct winning windows. Attacker pays about $100,000 in burned bridge bids this epoch for those 1,000 concurrent claim slots.
